personas.name: Hira Naz
personas.goal: What to wear today by weather
personas.headline: How Hira picks a scent before she leaves
personas.summary: Hira checks Today on phone, browses collection on iPad, journals notes on laptop.

day.title: Today pick
day.text: Hira opens Today on her phone — weather first, then a bottle suggestion she can accept or ignore in under a minute.

day.title: Bottle confirm
day.text: Bottle detail on the phone before it goes in the bag; notes from last wear stop her guessing in the hallway mirror.

day.title: iPad collection
day.text: Evening iPad browse through the collection feels like opening the cupboard without standing in front of it forever.

day.title: Laptop notes
day.text: Occasion notes on the laptop capture weddings and office days so next time is not a blank memory.

day.title: Calendar
day.text: Wear calendar on the laptop shows the week; she closes it knowing the decision took two minutes, not fifteen.

personas.name: James Cole
personas.headline: How James stopped losing decants
personas.summary: James logs decants on phone, collection on iPad, analytics on laptop.

day.title: Add decant
day.text: Before the commute James adds a decant on his phone so it has a home — not another orphan vial in the desk drawer.

day.title: Collection iPad
day.text: Lunchtime iPad collection view shows what he actually owns versus what he thinks he owns.

day.title: Analytics laptop
day.text: Laptop analytics are illustrative only; he uses them to notice gaps, not to chase a score.

day.title: Advisor
day.text: Rules-based advisor tips on the laptop — not magic, just cues he can dismiss without guilt.

day.title: Phone check
day.text: Phone Today for tomorrow’s wear. The decant finally has a row in the catalogue.

personas.name: Saad Alami
personas.headline: How Saad remembers what he already gifted
personas.summary: Saad notes gifts on phone, browses on iPad with his partner, plans on laptop.

day.title: Note a gift
day.text: After shopping Saad notes a gift on his phone — who, when, which bottle — so he stops accidentally regifting.

day.title: Browse together
day.text: Sofa iPad browse with his partner; they laugh at old notes and mark occasions without opening a chat archaeology dig.

day.title: Laptop plan
day.text: Laptop occasion list for the season; birthdays and dinners planned without relying on memory alone.

day.title: Today test
day.text: Today on the laptop for the weekend test wear; weather and notes in one calm screen.

day.title: Phone
day.text: Phone confirms the gift note. He will not buy the same bottle twice for the same cousin.
